authority.precedence: This JSON is the exact mechanical schema/order source; Markdown is its normative human rendering. A mismatch is an integrity failure.

json_document_profile.canonical_rule: RFC-8259-compatible JSON, sorted object keys, compact separators, ensure_ascii=false, UTF-8, then one LF.

planning_catalogue_reconciliation.issue: The controlling ten-phase sources freeze ordinals and full prose but do not assign semantic enum labels.
planning_catalogue_reconciliation.resolution: PhaseOrdinal members are neutral PHASE_1 through PHASE_10 only; /ten_phase_order.normative_text is the exact accepted name/meaning and cannot be shortened or replaced.
planning_catalogue_reconciliation.scope: Nomenclature only; no phase content or order changes.

planning_catalogue_reconciliation.issue: Canonical trace row, prefix, and payload hash domains and callables already exist in the accepted I-1 surface.
planning_catalogue_reconciliation.resolution: I-5 reuses compute_canonical_trace_row_hash, compute_canonical_trace_prefix_hash, and compute_canonical_trace_payload_hash byte-identically. TraceDigest is only a closed alias of their accepted result wrappers.
planning_catalogue_reconciliation.scope: No accepted domain, preimage, callable, result type, or export is duplicated or redefined.

planning_catalogue_reconciliation.issue: Plan §10.2 names the compact all-stage I-5 public families, while this task requires exact typed sub-outcomes, reconstruction evidence, T3 guards, and inert fault-hook declarations.
planning_catalogue_reconciliation.resolution: Every plan-named event, ownership, durability, and trace type is retained exactly; supplementary I-5 public records/enums make the task-required distinctions explicit. This amendment prospectively narrows only the I-5 catalogue and does not alter accepted I-1 through I-4 exports.
planning_catalogue_reconciliation.scope: Representational I-5 additions only; no scientific or backend decision.

planning_catalogue_reconciliation.issue: Plan §10.2 lists ScientificExecutionLease under capabilities, but the task-authorized I-5 path table assigns T3 entry/lease responsibility to new execution.py and does not authorize capabilities.py modification.
planning_catalogue_reconciliation.resolution: ScientificExecutionLease is declared by execution.py for I-5; capabilities.py remains byte-identical and supplies only the already accepted capability prerequisites.
planning_catalogue_reconciliation.scope: Narrow prospective I-5 ownership resolution; no lease is constructible under I-5.

planning_catalogue_reconciliation.issue: The plan names CommitOutcome while the task requires separate requested, committed, rejected, ambiguous, and unavailable evidence forms.
planning_catalogue_reconciliation.resolution: CommitOutcome is the exact five-member enum; AtomicCommitOutcome is its closed concrete evidence union, with DurablePrefixEvidence representing committed prefix evidence and separate inert failure evidence records.
planning_catalogue_reconciliation.scope: Typed abstract classification only; zero accepted stores.

ten_phase_order.name: PHASE_1
ten_phase_order.normative_text: Mature delayed effects and arrivals due at the start of epoch k.

ten_phase_order.name: PHASE_2
ten_phase_order.normative_text: Apply declared exogenous topology changes, failures, repairs, and capacity deratings effective at k.

ten_phase_order.name: PHASE_3
ten_phase_order.normative_text: Record the resulting state and make the permitted measurement available to the policy.

ten_phase_order.name: PHASE_4
ten_phase_order.normative_text: Propose starts, stops, reservations, releases, routes, and reroutes using only permitted information.

ten_phase_order.name: PHASE_5
ten_phase_order.normative_text: Screen prerequisites, deadlines, commitments, safety constraints, topology, and capacity.

ten_phase_order.name: PHASE_6
ten_phase_order.normative_text: Admit, reject, defer, or partially accept requests using the frozen allocation and queue disciplines.

ten_phase_order.name: PHASE_7
ten_phase_order.normative_text: Build joint-transition groups using the imported Part VI rule and form the exact joint-transition proposal for every accepted group without yet mutating physical state.

ten_phase_order.name: PHASE_8
ten_phase_order.normative_text: Validate a disjoint update-ownership record, then commit each proposed physical transition, completed flow, conversion, loss, consumption, congestion effect, expiry, resource use, and physical coordination burden exactly once while recording the corresponding accounts.

ten_phase_order.name: PHASE_9
ten_phase_order.normative_text: Register new in-transit payloads and delayed-effect events; update commitments, reservations, and unresolved statuses.

ten_phase_order.name: PHASE_10
ten_phase_order.normative_text: Apply declared natural drive for the remainder of the epoch and produce the end-of-epoch record.

runtime_conventions.records: exact frozen slotted dataclasses; post-init validates without mutation
runtime_conventions.enums: exact enum class; aliases and subclasses rejected
runtime_conventions.tuples: exact tuple in stated order; no list/set coercion
runtime_conventions.text: NFC and visible ASCII where identity vocabulary is specified
runtime_conventions.constructor_failure: I5_RECORD_FORMATION_INVALID unless an earlier accepted primitive formation failure owns the malformed primitive
runtime_conventions.determinism: No clock, randomness, process identity, filesystem enumeration, hash iteration, network input, callback, or scientific function affects an I-5 result.

event_contract.total_order: exact Python-independent lexicographic order over normalized field projections
event_contract.equal_key_rule: reject EVENT_KEY_DUPLICATE before predecessor or phase-cross checks
event_contract.phase_8_phase_9_rule: no phase-9 primary_object_id may equal a phase-8 committed primary_object_id in the same epoch
event_contract.simultaneity: common pre-state and joint proposal are recorded; child bookkeeping order has no physical meaning

ownership_contract.scope: all physical update claims for one epoch
ownership_contract.conflict: equal OpaqueLocusKey with unequal owner/event identity
ownership_contract.conflict_order: sort claims by [locus.namespace,locus.coordinate,event_key fields,owner_ref projection], inspect adjacent equal loci, report first pair
ownership_contract.informational_memory: Policy-memory ownership is informational and cannot enter EpochUpdateOwnership
ownership_contract.resolution: none; a conflict is rejection, not allocation

durability_contract.success: COMMITTED requires matching request, exactly one declared prefix extension, phase predecessor, and self-consistent evidence.
durability_contract.failure_prefix: REJECTED and UNAVAILABLE preserve byte-identical expected prefix.
durability_contract.ambiguity: AMBIGUOUS preserves only last confirmed evidence and is never silently retried or upgraded.
durability_contract.recovery_boundary: Recovery may inspect later evidence but is not implemented or authorized here.
durability_contract.python_object_nonclaim: Protocol conformance, an in-memory object, or a returned record is not evidence of durable atomicity.

trace_contract.prefix: literal concatenation of row frames; hash is over exact bytes under ebu.trace-prefix.v1
trace_contract.full_trace: header tag + literal prefix + exact completeness footer under ebu.full-trace.v1
trace_contract.immutability: accepted prefix bytes can only remain exact and become a literal leading prefix of a later separately authorized extension
trace_contract.byte_identical_extension: forbidden: an extension appends at least one row
trace_contract.gaps_equivocation: missing index, predecessor mismatch, conflicting bytes at an index, or inconsistent completeness fails closed
trace_contract.correction: never mutates or reinterprets historical trace; later linked correction authority required

required_bytes: literal framed trace rows and prefix bytes
excluded_data: domain payload values not needed by the listed determinations
minimum_reconstructable_trace.claim: Minimum for the inert I-5 reconstruction questions only, not for scientific replay in a later domain.

execution_boundary.t3_entry: requires accepted authorization use, binding, T3 capability, and a separately accepted real durability backend
execution_boundary.i5_backend_guard: always fails REAL_DURABILITY_BACKEND_UNAVAILABLE before a lease or callback
execution_boundary.callable_behavior: T3 signatures are prospective and fail-closed; I-5 implements no runner, orchestration body, callback dispatch, state step, schedule, world, or trajectory.
anti_disguise: registered/candidate state or policy implies T3
one tick or substep implies T3
unit-test naming does not reclassify scientific execution

UQ-29.i5_freezes: minimum/data-minimized inert reconstructable trace and literal durable-prefix granularity

failure_rule.projection: one code value plus LF in enum order

root_export_rule.projection: one export plus LF in exact root order

module_export_projection.rule: canonical JSON plus LF of [[module,exports]...] in module order

combined_signature_projection.ordering: accepted 155 rows unchanged, then 50 I-5 type rows, then 32 I-5 callable rows
combined_signature_projection.row_rule: [owner,TYPE-or-CALLABLE,module,name,complete declaration object] for I-5; accepted predecessor row rules unchanged

prohibited_imports: validation from execution or execution from validation

compatibility_reason: Accepted post-I-4 tests derive additive failures, exports, modules, edges, signatures, and hash-domain inventories; no historical compatibility test requires weakening or editing.

validation_authority.V6: opaque coordinates and inert event/ownership records only
validation_authority.V7: dummy bytes and inert abstract stores only; no real durability
validation_authority.V11: source/text/AST reachability only; execution module is not imported

mechanical_guarantees: Given exact valid records, EventKey comparison is a total lexicographic order.
The ownership validator deterministically reports the first exact opaque-locus conflict.
Literal trace-prefix verification detects any byte change, gap, predecessor mismatch, or empty extension claim.
The abstract transaction schema requires the listed records to share one commit outcome.
nonclaims: The records do not prove physical correctness, existence or uniqueness of dynamics, optimality, causality, settlement fairness, empirical validity, production durability, real-backend crash safety, distributed consensus, fault semantics, stochastic behavior, route behavior, recovery, publication, or a scientific result.
